hardware.candidate_role: USB/display signer malformed serial transport smoke
hardware.tested_state: existing flashed firmware image exercised by expanded serial transport smoke tooling

procedure: Added shared malformed serial transport vectors to the idf-smoke-capabilities exchange set.
Ran NostrSeal/esp32 make ci with 51 Python tests, host-core tests, compileall, and firmware validation.
Exported ESP-IDF v5.5.4 from /Users/vincenzo/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/export.sh in the same shell invocation used for hardware smoke.

Verified idf.py resolved under /Users/vincenzo/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/tools/idf.py, esptool.py resolved under /Users/vincenzo/.espressif/python_env/idf5.5_py3.9_env/bin/esptool.py, and idf.py --version reported ESP-IDF v5.5.4.
Ran make IDF_PORT=/dev/cu.usbmodem1101 idf-smoke-capabilities against the already-flashed 5280fab firmware image.

The smoke sent checksum-mismatch, malformed-base64url-payload, and overlong-frame transport vectors after valid fixture, dynamic request-id, invalid metadata, and serial-wrapped invalid signing-request exchanges.
expected_result: The attached board accepts the expanded protocol smoke, keeps valid sign_event responses at signing_disabled, rejects unsafe signing requests with unsupported_request, rejects malformed transport frames with malformed_frame, and rejects overlong transport input with overlong_frame.
observed_result: The expanded ESP32 hardware smoke passed with 38 verified USB serial exchanges: 8 response frames and 30 expected rejection frames. Valid get_capabilities, get_signing_status, get_public_key, and sign_event scaffold requests still responded deterministically; sign_event remained signing_disabled. Invalid request vectors returned unsupported_request. Malformed serial transport vectors returned malformed_frame or overlong_frame as expected.
limitations: This is protocol smoke for expanded serial transport rejection coverage, not a new manual visual display inspection.
The firmware image was not rebuilt or reflashed for this report; it reused the already-flashed 5280fab image because only smoke tooling, tests, and documentation changed.

The run does not validate production trusted-display acceptance, production physical-control acceptance, key provisioning, storage, secure boot, flash encryption, debug lock, companion signed-output verification, or real signing.
sign_event is expected to remain signing_disabled until every production signing gate is satisfied.
